description: This plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 24, with numeric tick labels provided at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," features a linear scale that ranges from 0.00 to 0.45, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four solid lines without marker shapes. The red line, representing "en&en," begins at a similarity of approximately 0.07 near layer 0, rises to an initial peak of roughly 0.27 at layer 6, declines and fluctuates to form a secondary peak around 0.18 at layer 12, decreases to a low of about 0.08 at layer 20, and sharply increases to end at roughly 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line, representing "en&es," starts near 0.06, climbs to a peak of approximately 0.24 at layer 6, dips before rising to a secondary peak of about 0.17 at layer 12, declines to nearly 0.05 at layer 20, and finishes with a sharp rise to roughly 0.27 at layer 23. The green line, representing "en&el," begins around 0.04, reaches a peak of exactly 0.15 at layer 6, dips and then peaks again at approximately 0.15 at layer 12, drops to roughly 0.04 at layers 19 and 20, and ends with a sharp increase to exactly 0.30 at layer 23. Finally, the pink line, representing "en&bn," starts at approximately 0.03, peaks near 0.14 at layer 6, experiences a secondary peak of roughly 0.14 at layer 12, decreases to a low around 0.05 at layers 19 and 20, and concludes with a sharp ascent to approximately 0.29 at layer 23.
